title: TenantSecurityMetricDetail - Data API
description: Stores detailed drill-down data for Security Center Health Check metrics. Each record contains dimension values and metric data for a specific metric type.

DateTimeValue1.description: Generic datetime storage field. Meaning depends on MetricIdentifier.

DateTimeValue2.description: Generic datetime storage field. Meaning depends on MetricIdentifier.

DetailIdentifier.description: The unique identifier for this detail record.

IntValue1.description: Generic integer storage field. Meaning depends on MetricIdentifier.

IntValue2.description: Generic integer storage field. Meaning depends on MetricIdentifier.

MetricIdentifier.description: The ID of the type of metric counted. This field is unique within your organization.

Name.description: The name of the metric for which the data is being collected.

TextValue1.description: Generic text storage field. Meaning depends on MetricIdentifier.

TextValue2.description: Generic text storage field. Meaning depends on MetricIdentifier.

TextValue3.description: Generic text storage field. Meaning depends on MetricIdentifier.

TextValue4.description: Generic text storage field. Meaning depends on MetricIdentifier.

TextValue5.description: Generic text storage field. Meaning depends on MetricIdentifier.

TextValue6.description: Generic text storage field. Meaning depends on MetricIdentifier.

TextValue7.description: Generic text storage field. Meaning depends on MetricIdentifier.

associated_objects:

- **TenantSecurityMetricDetailLink**: Represents the many-to-many join object between TenantSecurityMetricDetail and TenantSecurityMonitorMetric.
